title: graphql action
description: Posts a GraphQL query to an endpoint and replaces the body with the response; an error status fails the message.

query.title: Query
query.description: The query; "" takes the body as query

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: Variables of the query, a JSON object; "" for none

accessToken.title: Access token
accessToken.description: Sent as bearer token; "" for none

path.title: URL from the URI
path.description: From the URI graphql:<url>, when the option url is not set

trustStoreFile.title: Trust store
trustStoreFile.description: PKCS#12 keystore with the certificates to trust; "" trusts the system's roots

trustStorePassword.title: Trust store password
trustStorePassword.description: Trust store password; env DIF_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion)

socketTimeout.title: Timeout
socketTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for the response
